title: 图画作文的寓意
goal: 选出准确描述画面关系的句子；依据画面关系确定论述主题。

points.label: 选出准确描述画面关系的句子
依据画面关系确定论述主题

sources.title: 大学英语六级（CET-6）：课表
sources.used: 写作部分：图画作文的寓意；内容范围、知识点与客观题规格。

body.p: 描述画面时，写出人物、动作和他们之间的关系。解释寓意时，把这些关系概括成一个可以讨论的问题。画面没有给出的动机、经历和结果，不写成事实。寓意从人物和动作的关系得出，不凭一个孤立的物品决定。

body.box: One person places a cup beside an empty return tray; another carries a cup to the tray.

body.p: 描述时比较两人杯子的位置和动作。主题可以是公共场所中的归还责任。前一人是否故意给工作人员添麻烦，画面没有交代，不能写。

steps.d: 列出人物、物品、动作和文字。places a cup beside the tray 与 carries a cup to the tray 是不同位置关系。
判断两部分是并列、先后还是对比，要有画面依据。两幅图并排而没有时间标记时，不写成同一人的前后变化。
从画面关系引出抽象问题。归还与未归还的对比，可以引出个人行为与公共秩序的话题。
把事实描述和寓意判断分开。The contrast suggests … 表示解释；does this deliberately 则加上了画面没有的动机。

cards.title: 画面信息与限制
rows: 人物
依据动作或标签确定身份，不凭服饰猜职业。
A person holds a clipboard beside the return tray.
动作
区分正在做、已做完和打算做。画中的姿势说明不了结果。
A person is reaching toward a cup; the cup remains on the table.
对比
写出双方共同涉及的物品，再写差别。
One cup is beside the tray, while another is being carried toward it.
先后
有时间标记或明确的连续动作，才写前后变化。
The panel marked Later shows the same table without cups.
动机
文字和画面都没有交代时，不写人物的意图。
The cup is outside the tray; the person's reason is not shown.

cards.title: 画面关系与寓意
rows: Two students stand beside separate stacks of boxes; each tries to lift a stack alone.
Both students are lifting boxes independently.
可以讨论各自独立完成任务。画面没有显示两人拒绝合作。
In a second panel, the same two students lift one large box together.
The second panel shows the students sharing the lifting task.
前后对照支持协作的主题。效率提高多少，画面没有显示。
A visitor photographs a sign reading Keep the path clear while standing in the marked path.
The visitor records the instruction while occupying the path it refers to.
言行不一致有画面依据。拍照的动机不知道。
A cyclist stops before a crossing while another cycles past the stop line.
The riders differ in their response to the same marked boundary.
可以讨论遵守规则。画面没有事故或处罚。

body.box: Picture description: Two panels show a shared office supply cupboard. In the first, a worker places an empty box back on the shelf beside a notice reading Report empty supplies. In the second, another worker finds the box empty while reaching for supplies. No speech bubbles explain either worker's thoughts, and no clock indicates how much time has passed.

Description 1: A worker returns an empty box, and another later finds no supplies inside.
Description 2: A worker deliberately deceives a colleague to avoid paying for supplies.

body.p: 第一句保留了两个动作和先后关系。第二句加上了 deliberately deceives 和 avoid paying，画面既没有欺骗的动机，也没有费用信息。

body.box: The sequence suggests that failing to report depleted shared supplies can shift a practical difficulty to the next user.

body.p: 寓意把没有报告空盒和下一个人用不上物资联系起来。它只说明这一种情况，不说所有物资短缺都是个人隐瞒造成的。

cards.title: 干扰项
rows: 位置颠倒
A cup beside the tray → a cup inside the tray.
按物品与参照物的位置核对。
动机补写
The worker returns the box to punish a colleague.
画面只显示放回的动作，没有惩罚的意图。
结果补写
The cyclist causes an accident beyond the crossing.
画面没有事故，不写成已经发生。
抽象过度
An empty supply box proves that all shared offices fail.
一个场景支持不了关于所有场所的判断。

groups.text: Picture description: In the left panel, two people each pull one end of a folded banner in opposite directions. In the right panel, they place it on a table and unfold it together. No time measurements appear.

options: Both panels show the people completing the banner alone.
The right panel shows one person pulling while the other watches.
The left panel shows the banner already spread across a table.
Separate pulling is contrasted with a coordinated action at the table.
items.why: each pull … in opposite directions 和 unfold it together 是两种动作方式的对比，第四项保留了这一对比。

items.stem: Which theme follows most directly from the two actions?
options: Coordination can help people work toward a shared practical goal.
People finish every shared task faster when they use a table.
Pulling in opposite directions proves that the people dislike each other.
The banner's size determines whether cooperation is possible.
items.why: opposite directions 和 together 的对比支持协调的主题，即第一项。第二项加上了速度，画面没有时间信息。

groups.text: Picture description: A person displays a poster reading Save paper while handing out several unnecessary copies of that same poster to one visitor.

items.stem: Which statement stays with the visible information?
options: The visitor demands extra copies despite having read the poster.
A paper-saving message accompanies the distribution of extra copies.
The person prints extra copies because the visitor cannot read.
The visitor throws every copy away after leaving the display.
items.why: Save paper 和 unnecessary copies 是标语和行为的对照，第二项只写了这一点。访客的要求、发放的动机和之后是否丢弃，画面都没有。

groups.text: Picture description: Two people stand at a notice board. One points to a schedule labeled Updated; the other holds a sheet labeled Previous schedule. Both look at the new board.

items.stem: Which topic is supported without inventing a motive?
options: Why one person intentionally hides a timetable from another.
Why printed timetables should replace every public notice board.
The importance of checking whether practical information is current.
The superiority of one person's memory over another person's memory.
items.why: Updated 和 Previous schedule 支持核对信息是否最新这一主题，即第三项。两人都在看新公告，画面没有隐瞒的情节。

groups.text: Picture description: A sequence shows a shared picnic table before and after a group leaves. In the first panel, several people are eating, with wrappers beside their plates. In the panel marked After the picnic, the people have gone and wrappers remain on the tabletop. A bin stands nearby in both panels. The drawing supplies no speech or explanation of why the wrappers were left, and it does not show what happens later.

options: The group leaves wrappers on the table despite a nearby bin.
The group leaves because the nearby bin is already full.
The group plans to return and collect every remaining wrapper.
The group moves wrappers from the bin onto the picnic table.
items.why: wrappers remain on the tabletop 和 A bin stands nearby 支持第一项。第二项加上了垃圾桶已满这个原因，画面没有说明。

items.stem: Express a theme grounded in the sequence.
items.tail: their own waste after a meal rather than leave it for the next visitors.
items.why: the responsibility of … to clear 说明使用者有清理的责任。responsibility 后面接不定式 to clear，不用 cleared。

groups.text: Picture description: A drawing shows a public book-exchange cabinet. A notice on its door reads Return books in usable condition. On the left, a person places a book with several detached pages into the cabinet. On the right, another person opens that book and holds one of the loose pages. Arrows indicate the sequence of these actions. Neither person speaks. Write about the relation between contributing to a shared resource and considering its next user. Base the description and interpretation on the shown actions.

items.stem: Which sentence accurately describes the sequence?
options: A reader repairs loose pages before placing a book in the cabinet.
A damaged book is deposited and then opened by another user.
The second user detaches pages from a previously undamaged book.
The first user removes a notice before returning a borrowed book.
items.why: places a book with several detached pages 和 another person opens that book 说明书放进去时已经破损，之后才被另一人打开，即第二项。

items.stem: Which central issue is best supported by the drawing?
options: Why readers deliberately damage books after taking them home.
Why cabinets should accept books without regard to their condition.
Whether a contribution remains useful to the next person using it.
Whether reading a damaged book always prevents understanding.
items.why: usable condition 和后面的 loose pages 一起支持第三项：捐出的书对下一个人是否有用。第一项加上了故意损坏的动机。

items.stem: Describe the book at the time it enters the cabinet.
chunks: with detached pages inside the cabinet
items.tail: opens it and encounters the same damaged pages during the next stage of the sequence.
items.why: places 是主句谓语，不用 placing。with detached pages 说明书放入时的状态，before another person 引出之后的使用。

items.stem: State a theme without adding a hidden motive.
items.tail: when a shared resource depends on people returning items in usable condition.
items.why: whether a contribution meets 提出要讨论的问题，从句谓语用 meets。主题来自 usable condition，不需要假定有人故意。

groups.text: Picture description: Two panels show a group preparing an outdoor performance. In the first, each member studies a separate plan, and arrows on the plans point to different positions for the same stage. In the second, the members gather around one plan and mark a single stage location together. The panels show no audience, finished performance, or financial information. Write about the contrast in planning and its possible significance for collective work. Avoid treating the drawing as proof of an event's eventual success.

items.stem: Which account preserves the difference between the panels?
options: The members replace a shared plan with separate stage locations.
The audience selects a stage after rejecting the group's separate plans.
The members compare the financial cost of two completed performances.
Conflicting separate plans give way to a jointly marked stage location.
items.why: different positions for the same stage 和 a single stage location 构成对比：先是各自的计划互相冲突，后是共同确定位置，即第四项。

items.stem: Which theme has the clearest support?
options: Shared planning can align separate contributions before collective action.
A single stage location guarantees that every performance will succeed.
Members work together only after an audience approves the stage.
Outdoor performances cost less when plans contain fewer arrows.
items.why: gather around one plan and mark a single stage location together 支持第一项。第二项写成了保证成功，画面没有演出的结果。

items.stem: Describe the action in the second panel.
items.tail: instead of retaining separate plans that assign the same stage to different positions.
items.why: shows the group members marking 描述看得见的动作，marking 不换成 marked。on a shared plan 说明标在哪份计划上。

items.stem: Limit the interpretation to what the contrast supports.
items.tail: without establishing whether the outdoor performance will eventually succeed or attract a large audience.
items.why: that shared planning can reduce 是有限度的判断，can 表示可能。about the arrangement 说明分歧的内容。
